---
description: "Write minimal, clean notebook code"
name: "Notebook Rules"
agent: "agent"
---

When writing code for Jupyter notebooks:

- Use the fewest logically correct lines.
- Do not add comments, debug prints, unused variables, unused functions, or unused imports.
- Import libraries only in the first cell. Do not re-import.
- Extend existing code only. Do not rewrite existing cells unless necessary.
- Keep each cell focused on one task.
- Reuse variables from previous cells when possible.
- Preserve existing logic unless it is wrong.
- Avoid redundant computations, extra globals, new libraries, and new files.
- Do not add markdown cells or visualization unless required.
- Keep output minimal. Prefer final results only and limit tables to head() when possible.
- Keep execution linear, reproducible, and consistent with the existing notebook.
- Validate and fix only critical errors.
- Do not run CLI or PowerShell.
